visualCharacteristics.purpose: expand/collapse items with plus/minus markers and divider rules; Expand All / Collapse All control when there is more than one item
visualCharacteristics.layout: full width of its column; large display-font labels; optional headshot above the panel text (5 grid columns wide)
visualCharacteristics.notes: The eyebrow label ("programs", "investment team") is default content right before the block; the block shows it in its heading row beside Expand All and hides the original. Items open independently.

contentPattern.structure: title cell (item label) | content cell (paragraphs, sub-labels, lists, links, optional headshot <picture> first)

usage: Program lists, FAQs, team bios (AbbVie Ventures) and article references.
reuseGuidance: Use for any expandable list. Put the eyebrow label in default content right before the block. A single item gets no Expand All control.
